dialogues.dialogue: Wow! What an intense battle! And very close, too! Still, another victory closer for the Sonatine.
Grand Mal is really stepping up their game, but will it be close enough to pull them through the finals against the Sonatine?
Only just gotten started, huh?
(Serena glares hard at Joan, clenching her bass tightly.)
(Joan notices and nervously fidgets, filling herself with regrets again.)
Sorry... I was being insensitive again, right?
But... that bass line...
It was pretty impressive. Can't believe I overlooked it before. You totally deserve a solo.
You'll have to show me that some time.
Yeah... Thanks. I can't believe you overlooked it before, too. I bet you can't even remember what you did.
(Serena laughs bitterly.)
Remember when you called me out in front of the whole band for being 'selfish' and wanting to play something outside your oppressive melody?
You made me sound like I was trying to be different from everyone else, and that my ears were wasted along with my music taste.
You don't know how embarassed I felt that day... It was the first time I ever felt... I guess, resentful of you.
I still remembered how much I looked up to you when we first started.
You always had a way of gravitating people towards you with your music. Our music.
I always envied and admired you for that.
(Joan awkwardly stares back as Serena tries her hardest to hold back her tears.)
You're right.
I guess I never realized the golden pick that I've lost till I've given it up.
No one can really hold you back anymore now, can they?
(For a moment, Serena smiles.)
And now, what you have all been waiting for... the finale of Revolution Summer!
Which band will pull the hardest on the strings of our audience and judges?
(Joan and Serena both exchange an intense stare without malice, but understanding.)
Bands, are you ready?
